PHP IS DEAD (AGAIN) — AUDIO CUE SHEET
20.000 seconds / 960000 sample frames / stereo / 48000 Hz / PCM 24-bit
All cue times are seconds from composition start. Place mix.wav at time zero.
Do not stretch, offset, loop, or separately normalize segments.

0.12, 1.00, 1.58: three huge synthesized low punches with metallic noise debris.
3.10, 4.40, 5.48, 6.36, 7.05: mechanical timeline stamps.
7.35, 7.55, 7.72: additional accelerating stamps.
8.00 <= t < 10.00: EXACT DIGITAL ZERO, no meanwhile pad or residual echo.
  Sample frames 384000 through 479999 inclusive are zero in mix and all stems.
10.00: original ridiculous heroic brass-like chord swell begins in D.
11.00: build shifts to Bb; 12.00: G; 13.00: A-suspended.
  Increasing low downbeats at exactly 10, 11, 12, 13 seconds.
14.25: heroic D-major peak.
14.55: abrupt guillotine cutoff of every hero voice and reflection.
  One-millisecond terminal de-click avoids an unintended digital pop.
14.55 <= t < 15.20: EXACT DIGITAL ZERO.
14.65: visual BRO receives silence, NOT voiceover or an extra musical hit.
15.20, 15.65, 16.25: restrained dry low phrase punctuation, no reverb.
18.10, 18.18, 18.235, 18.33, 18.405, 18.47, 18.545: minimal keyboard.
  Every typing transient ends by 18.600; no continuous keyboard bed.
18.85: small clean two-tone reveal glint, no tail beyond 19.07.
19.63: final dry key, ending by 19.695.
19.85 <= t < 20.00: EXACT DIGITAL ZERO (in practice silence begins earlier).

MASTERING AND CODEC NOTES
The final WAV is normalized using actual FFmpeg two-pass loudnorm followed by
oversampled peak control. Required zero regions are enforced after processing,
then the delivered WAV is remeasured. Metrics are measured, not inferred.
Target decoded AAC: -14 LUFS +/- 1 LU; true peak at most -1 dBTP.
Conservative WAV ceiling: at most -2 dBTP. See metrics.json for actual values.

AAC is transform/block based: it can smear tiny nonzero energy across exact
boundaries and add encoder padding. Therefore exact zero-boundary guarantees
apply to the authoritative WAV and stems, not to lossy decoded AAC samples.
AAC silence interiors and decoded frame count are separately measured and saved.
Use the WAV master for rendering; the retained AAC is a QC reference.

STEMS
All five stems are stereo 48 kHz, 24-bit and exactly 20 seconds, starting at zero.
The hero stem is zero outside the heroic passage, including after 14.55.
The final mastered WAV has shared dynamics processing; summing premaster stems
reconstructs the premaster, not the final mastered signal. Do not play stems on
top of mix.wav. No VO or external samples are present.
